page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-core ratio position this instance as a specialized resource for memory-intensive workloads, offering a balanced trade-off between compute power and large memory capacity without the overhead of bundled local storage or GPU hardware.

Given its memory-optimized profile, the ecs.r7se.16xlarge is designed for workloads requiring significant RAM capacity, such as large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data caching layers, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
